testcases.title: E2E-TOP-CONCEPT-001 - Top Concepts — Sort modes apply correctly

steps.title: Given an authenticated user opens the category page with concepts
When the user opens the Sort dropdown and applies Sort by Frequency
Then the concept list is monotonically ordered by frequency percentage
When the user applies Sort by Sentiment
Then the concept list is grouped by sentiment bucket (Positive/Mixed/Negative)
When the user applies Sort A-Z
Then the concept list is sorted alphabetically by concept name

testcases.title: E2E-TOP-CONCEPT-002 - Top Concepts — Sentiment filter colors

steps.title: Given an authenticated user opens the category page with concepts
When the user clicks the Positive sentiment filter
Then every visible concept carries a green sentiment indicator (or none if filter is empty)
When the user clicks the Negative sentiment filter
Then every visible concept carries a red sentiment indicator (or none if filter is empty)
When the user clicks the Mixed sentiment filter
Then every visible concept carries a yellow sentiment indicator (or none if filter is empty)
When the user clicks the All filter to restore the full list

testcases.title: E2E-TOP-CONCEPT-003 - Top Concepts — Detail panel coherence (title color sections)

steps.title: Given an authenticated user opens the category page with concepts
When the user captures the first concept name and sentiment color from the list
And the user clicks the first concept
Then the panel heading text matches the selected concept name
And the panel header banner color matches the concept list-row sentiment color
And the Sources section heading is visible in the panel
And Positive/Negative sentiment indicators are visible in the panel

testcases.title: E2E-TOP-CONCEPT-004 - Top Concepts — Sources structure (title subtitle publisher logo LLM logo nav)

steps.title: Given an authenticated user opens the category page with concepts
When the user opens the detail panel of the first concept
And the user switches to the Sources section inside the panel
Then every source row in the detail panel carries a title, subtitle, publisher logo, at least one LLM logo image, and a navigation link
When the user opens the All sources modal
Then every source row in the All sources modal carries a title, subtitle, publisher logo, at least one LLM logo image, and a navigation link
And the All sources modal contains at least as many source rows as the panel (full set vs subset)
